# Spiritual Translation of the Chapter of Begin nings

** ¶1:** The origin of every infl ux of spiritual good is the Divine Love itself, the in most source of all wisdom ; since all goods flow into the soul from His will alone .

**¶2:** The origin of every state of b lessedness and every turning of the mind toward the Divine is the Divine Truth proce eding from love , the first breath of spiritual life — that recept ive principle through which the Divine is brought forth into form .

**¶3:** The origin of every interior perception of what ought to be done is the Divine Wisdom operating within the natural degree of the mind — the governing truth of the celest ial kingdom that is present even within the out most things of thought , proce eding from the Divine Love itself .

**¶4:** The origin of all acknowledg ment of the Divine, and of all true reve rence, is the in most aff ection for wisdom — the love of truth for the sake of truth — which alone is worthy of being ex alted.

**¶5 :** The origin of all power to persu ade the will and to pursue scattered aff ections and bring them into order is the prim ordial celest ial state — the first spiritual vol ition given to humanity .

**¶6:** The origin of all capacity for spiritual combat against fals ity and evil is the Divine Proce eding that animates the regener ating will — the life -giving principle that has distributed its five interior faculties of spiritual perception throughout every degree of the mind, from the in most to the out most.

**¶7:** The origin of all power to form doctrine and to construct the interior framework of the spiritual mind is the Divine Intelligence that orders all tru ths into their heav enly form .

**¶8:** The first and chief of all capac ities for sust aining the weight of divine infl ux is the central axis of Divine Truth itself — the supporting column through which all that is above flows into all that is below.

**¶ 9:** The origin of all liberation from falsity and bond age to evil is Divine Truth made manifest in full ness; the red eeming principle that f rees every faculty that belongs to the interior man through the power of tru ths received and understood .

**¶10:** The origin of every interior perception of genuine truth is the pure affection for wisdom unc orrupted by any self -derived falsity — the virg inal love of truth in its own light .

**¶11:** The origin of all illumin ation in those who receive the highest goods is the Divine Rational itself desc ending into the human mind — that which r ouses the understanding from its sleep of ignorance and g athers into unity all the goods and truths that have been dispers ed and frag mented throughout the di sordered natural mind.
